summary:
Everything an engine stage may check in SL-107's hand-off holds at HEAD 8dfc8c9. The deliverable itself does not exist yet: .taad/slices/SL-089/c-drive-run.json, written by a whole-C:\ W-001 run, is the person's to make. Criteria 1-5 are graded person-run.

**Hand-off cases.** C-001, C-002 and C-003 passed.
- C-001: the cmd.exe line `-Root "C:\"` arrives as `C:"`. The run then exits 1, prints 'is not a folder', and writes no record.
- C-002: SL-089-seams.md warns about cmd.exe and points to the SL-107 doc.
- C-003: the SL-107 doc holds every required string, including the UTF-8 line placed before the tee.

**Bounded W-001 runs of the published app on this PC.** Both ended PASSED with verdict held, and pool moved 2 MB or less.
- C-005 over C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows: 448 rows = header = coreUnreadable, notScanned 1, 0 leaks. Build saw 449, so one row of churn.
- C-006 over fsa-guard-tests: 27 rows, all tallied as code-363 leftovers, none opened.

**Whole-drive branch.** I did not scan D:\: a whole-drive scan needs the person's allowance. Instead I ran W-001 on a subst T: over a 3-folder temp tree, as `T:\` and as `T:` with no backslash.
- Both runs: PASSED, scope whole-drive, wcifs-layer-store check ok, record written to artifacts\w001-run.json, C: record still absent, all 3 folders scanned.
- The subst mapping and the tree were removed afterwards.

**Other checks.**
- Oracle corpus: 21/21 pass, including rows F02 (leak) and F12 (code 1920 classed other-code).
- Full suite: 964/964.
- rules-parity: AGREE.
- The harness test that plants over an existing record: 4/4.
- The record-path rule corpus: All checks held.
- Fitness: pass, 95 rules. The new rule matches no file until the record exists (Q-012).
- The full rules-harness run required by Q-027 (engine 387f099): 167/167 AS-RECORDED, exit 0. S83-S86 fire and P36 stays quiet.

**Not checked: the TIMEOUT and elevated endings (criteria 9 and 10).** I only read the code for these.

**Two findings, filed to the backlog (`extra`):**
1. The doc replaces Q-261's decided 27-28 range for the code-363 count with "equal to the same-session Temp anchor". Critique M2 and O-017 asked for that, but it overrides an answered decision. The two rules agree today (27 + 1 = 28).
2. The committed design-slice-1.json still says would_force_resynthesis true, against O-015's account. Per Q-106 that file is an engine export, so a file edit cannot fix it.

O-001 holds: every reconciling item has a measurement or a stated bound. Item (a) is bounded only below, plus the same-session floor.

criteria.criterion: 1. hand the person the whole-C:\ command — when it is typed in cmd.exe as -Root "C:\"
criteria.how: C-001 passed. The real cmd.exe line delivers C:" and W-001 then exits 1 with 'C:" is not a folder' and FAILED: W-001, writing no record. The SL-107 doc section 1.1 and its endings table say so.

criteria.criterion: 2. hand the person the whole-C:\ command — when the person reads only SL-089-seams.md
criteria.how: C-002 passed. The 'Criterion 3 on C:\ is a person's run' section names cmd.exe and what arrives, keeps the pwsh command, and points to docs/design/SL-107-c-drive-run.md.

criteria.criterion: 3. hand the person the whole-C:\ command — when the person reads only the SL-107 hand-off doc
criteria.how: C-003 passed, 38/38. I also read the whole doc. It has the command, the New-Item and UTF-8 lines before the tee, the endings table, the fields table for criteria 1-4, the criterion-5 reconciliation with a same-session anchor floor, and what to commit and where.

criteria.criterion: 4. run W-001 over a whole drive — when the root is a whole volume other than C: (D:\)
criteria.how: I did not run D:\ itself: a whole-drive scan needs an allowance. I ran a subst T:\ instead, which W-001 treats as a whole drive (GetPathRoot), with the same branch and code. Result: PASSED, scope whole-drive, wcifs check ok, record to artifacts\w001-run.json, C record absent. The spike's real D:\ run at bd6572f (held, 2 rows) used the same WindowCases.ps1, which is unchanged since.

criteria.criterion: 5. run W-001 over a tree that holds the container layer store — precaution on, root above the store
criteria.how: C-005 passed: notScanned 1, 448 rows = header = coreUnreadable, 0 leaks, verdict held.

criteria.criterion: 6. run W-001 over the fixtures criterion 5 counts — stuck cloud placeholders failing at open with 363
criteria.how: C-006 passed: 27 rows, all leftover-363, oracle opened 0, openedNothingListed 0. The 28th folder (fsa-validate-2\dirtag\nonempty) still fails with 363.

criteria.criterion: 7. classify a panel row — a NothingListed row with code 1920
criteria.how: Corpus row F12 (NothingListed, 1920, expect other-code) passes in W001OracleTests (21/21). The spike also ran a real code-1920 row through every check, verdict held.

criteria.criterion: 8. classify a panel row — a code-5 row whose folder opens (the leak)
criteria.how: Corpus row F02 (code 5, listable, expect leak) passes. The LEAK: console line is at WindowCases.ps1:6244, and the doc's leak paragraph names it.

criteria.criterion: 9. the whole-C:\ run ends — app still running when the 1,200 s wait expires
criteria.how: I only read the code: the run fails 'a report was written' and returns at :6226 without writing a record, and the doc's TIMEOUT row matches. Exercising it needs a scan longer than 1,200 s or a code change. The design rated it not material.

criteria.criterion: 10. the whole-C:\ run ends — when the shell is elevated
criteria.how: I only read the code: Inconclusive at WindowCases.ps1:6206-6208, before any case folder or scan, and the doc's row matches. A Sandbox run would need pwsh 7, a ~300 MB SDK download and a full publish before line 6206 is reached. Not done.

criteria.criterion: 11. the whole-C:\ run ends — when the wcifs-layer-store precaution is off for the whole drive
criteria.how: Turning the precaution off means clicking the app's Settings checkbox and its confirmation during the run, and I may not drive another program's windows. A person runs W-001 -Root on a subst letter over a small tree (never C:), turns the checkbox off in Settings when the window appears, and confirms. The run must end FAILED with the FAIL line 'the wcifs-layer-store precaution was on...'. The positive arm (precaution on, ok line) was measured here on T:\.

criteria.criterion: 12. the whole-C:\ run ends — when the person stops or closes the app mid-scan
criteria.how: This needs a click on the app's Stop or Close. A person runs W-001 over a folder big enough to stop by hand (e.g. C:\Windows, not C:\) and presses Stop mid-scan. The run must end FAILED, and if a record is written its status must be Cancelled and its verdict failed. The doc says not to commit such a record.

criteria.criterion: 13. resolve the whole-drive root — -Root C: without the trailing backslash
criteria.how: Measured on subst T: with -Root T:: whole-drive scope, all 3 folders scanned, PASSED. Read: LongPath.cs:37-38 appends '\' before GetFullPath, so a bare C: is the root whatever the current directory on C: is. WindowCases.ps1:6210/6293 send 'C:' to the C: record. The per-drive current-directory case was not exercised on C: itself.

criteria.criterion: 14. commit the person's record — when the committed file contains a path
criteria.how: In the full harness run against the engine's Fitness (Q-027), the plant rows S83 (UNC), S84 (single backslashes), S85 (relative slashes) and S86 (path key) fire, and P36 (a real record) stays quiet: 167/167 AS-RECORDED. The 44-row corpus test passed, and every writer row is quiet.

criteria.criterion: P1. A person ran W-001 over whole C:\ unelevated from pwsh with the precaution on, and c-drive-run.json was written (whole-drive, elevated false, checkerElevated false, checkerControls all true, verdict held)
criteria.how: From a checkout of the branch carrying SL-107's merge, in unelevated pwsh, run the three lines of docs/design/SL-107-c-drive-run.md section 2 (New-Item artifacts; UTF-8 output; WindowCases.ps1 -Case W-001 -Root C:\ teed to artifacts\c-drive-console.txt). The last line must be PASSED: W-001 after a record: ...c-drive-run.json line. The record must show scope whole-drive, elevated false, checkerElevated false, status Completed, all checkerControls true and verdict held.

criteria.criterion: P2. rows = header = coreUnreadable in c-drive-run.json
criteria.how: In the committed record, rows, header and coreUnreadable must be one number, expected at most 682 (about 645-660).

criteria.criterion: P3. No refused-then-listed folder is a row
criteria.how: In the record, oracle.openRefusedButOpenable must be 0, and artifacts\c-drive-console.txt must contain no 'LEAK:' line.

criteria.criterion: P4. No empty reason, no duplicates
criteria.how: In the record, emptyReasons must be 0 and duplicates 0.

criteria.criterion: P5. Whole-drive counts reconciled with 682-684 (Q-261 as amended by the doc)
criteria.how: After the C:\ run, run the three anchors in doc section 5 (C:\Windows, C:\ProgramData, %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp) and copy each record. Requirements: notScanned 1; code 1920 0-2; rows at most 682 and at least the sum of the anchors' rows, within churn. For code 363, Q-261 decided 27-28, while the doc requires it to equal the Temp anchor's count (see the extra check). The result table in the doc must be filled in, and the remainder named.

obligations.evidence:
Section 5 of docs/design/SL-107-c-drive-run.md gives every reconciling item either a measurement or a stated bound. I re-measured what I could today:
- (a) Layers rows: bounded below at 25 (U-112's groups 10+8+7). The upper end is stated as unmeasurable because the path lists are gone. A same-session floor bounds the whole: rows(C:) must be at least the sum of three anchor runs.
- (b) WER: 438 from the survey. My C-005 run gave 448 for ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows.
- (c) Code 1920: 2 down to 0. All 3 stand-in-bin folders are plain Directory today, with no reparse attribute.
- (d) Code 363: 27 today in C-006. The 28th folder, fsa-validate-2\dirtag\nonempty, exists and fails with 363 (0x8007016B).
- (e) +1 for W-001's own control-denied folder. Read from Test-W001/Get-CheckerControls: the case folder is under %TEMP%, which is inside C:\ and inside the Temp anchor, so the +1 cancels.
- (f) Churn: measured on the day by the Temp anchor.
- Ceiling: 682 (Q-261).
Item (a) has only a lower bound. The floor exists only once the person runs the anchors.

not_reached: The slice's deliverable: the whole-C:\ W-001 run and the committed .taad/slices/SL-089/c-drive-run.json. Its rows, codes, notScanned, leaks and kernel-pool growth (Q-193; about 537 MB expected) are all unmeasured at this HEAD.
The same-session anchor floor (W-001 over C:\Windows, C:\ProgramData and %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp) has never been run end to end. Today's counts for the C:\ProgramData and Temp anchors are unknown.

D:\ as a real whole volume at this HEAD. It was not scanned without an allowance and was replaced by a subst letter over a temp tree. The spike's D:\ run was at bd6572f, and WindowCases.ps1 is unchanged since.
The TIMEOUT ending (app still running at 1,200 s): only read in the code. A real cold C: scan may take 400-1,600 s (lesson #174 recorded 1,299 s).
The elevated ending, and the endings with the precaution off or the app stopped or closed mid-scan. The first was only read; the other two need clicks in the app's windows.
Resolving -Root C: when the current directory on C: is not the root. Only shown by reading LongPath.cs:37-38; the subst letter had no per-drive current directory.
Whether the path rule stays quiet on the person's real committed record. Plant row P36 and the writer rows in the corpus stand in for it.
